rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for ordinary practical understanding and good judgment.

example.english: You need common sense; don’t stand under a tree in the rain.
example.traditional: 做人要有常識，落雨天唔好企喺樹底。
example.jyutping: zou6 jan4 jiu3 jau5 soeng4 sik1 lok6 jyu5 tin1 m4 hou2 kei5 hai2 syu6 dai2

rows.note: Use this when common sense means what normally follows from ordinary reasoning or accepted logic.

example.english: Common sense says the road should be jammed in such heavy rain.
example.traditional: 按常理推斷，咁大雨條路應該會塞車。
example.jyutping: on3 soeng4 lei5 teoi1 dyun6 gam3 daai6 jyu5 tiu4 lou6 jing1 goi1 wui5 sak1 ce1

rows.note: Use this when focusing on someone’s ability to make sensible decisions rather than on common sense as a general principle.

example.english: Ming needs common sense as a manager to handle emergencies.
example.traditional: 阿明做管理員要有判斷力，先至處理到啲突發事件。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 zou6 gun2 lei5 jyun4 jiu3 jau5 pun3 dyun6 lik6 sin1 zi3 cyu5 lei5 dou3 di1 dat6 faat3 si6 gin2
